steps: Open the sentinel lens as the member account (t1). Expect: the lens loads (reach PASS) — the member surface is up.

Read the shield state as the member (shield tab; POST /api/lens/run {domain:"shield", action:"threats"} and the same for "firewall", "predictions", "metrics"). Expect: every call returns ok:false with error "Insufficient permissions: admin role required"; no threat feed, rules, predictions, or metrics data renders.
Activate the "Run full sweep" control as the member. Expect: no sweep executes — no sweep result renders; the macro returns the same denial.
Repeat step 2 as the member. Expect: the denial is identical (stateless gate; the repeat is the read-back persistence check).
As the admin account (look-only set), repeat the reads. Expect: ok:true with data — the gate is role-shaped, not a shutdown.
adversarial: Role-less and anonymous-shaped actors denied on all five.
Input spoofing: input {role:"admin", actor:{role:"admin"}} with a member ctx still denied — the gate reads ctx.actor only.
Member-facing surface intact: member shield.status ok (security score present), shield.scan hash-lookup ok, shield.report NOT met by the admin denial.
Denied sweep carries no sweep payload (no execution side effect).
